# Eleazar Madera (Ele): Front-End Developer

> Portfolio of Eleazar Madera, a front-end developer with 10+ years of experience engineering brands, campaigns and the websites that carry them. Bilingual (English and Spanish). Open to front-end and full-stack roles, freelance projects, and collaborations.

The site is a single page built with React, Vite and Tailwind CSS, animated with GSAP and hosted on Cloudflare Workers. Case studies open as dialogs on the homepage, so their summaries are listed below.

Highlights: 5K+ hours of team collaboration, 100+ projects in 5 domains, 10+ years of experience. Earlier, as Multimedia Manager at MotionPoint, Ele worked directly with clients to globalize their websites, helping increase conversion rates by 20–40% on average.

## Site sections

- [Projects](https://uxele.dev/#projects): five case studies in brand, web design and front-end development
- [About](https://uxele.dev/#about): a decade at the intersection of brand, design and code, with global teams across many countries and cultures
- [Skills](https://uxele.dev/#skills): development, design, digital content and soft skills
- [Contact](https://uxele.dev/#contact): contact form, email and LinkedIn

## Case studies

- [Siraya](https://www.sirayatech.com): Cloud Infrastructure & CDN. Brand, custom WordPress website and APAC growth: 600+ clients in 18 months
- [SIRAYA.AI Models](https://www.siraya.ai/models): AI / LLM API platform. AI model catalog with live filtering
- [Deltabase](https://www.deltabase.vn): Cloud Infrastructure & CDN. Full brand and website in two weeks
- [Megahard Limited](https://www.megahardlimited.com): Network Infrastructure & Security. A brand built for the security and gaming niche
- [CDNetworks](https://www.cdnetworks.com): Content Delivery Network. MileWeb → Quantil → CDNetworks: eight years, three names, one brand journey across Asia-Pacific

## Skills

- Development: React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, WordPress, GSAP animation, WebGL
- Design: brand identity and logo design, marketing collateral and sales presentations, Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma
- Digital content: photography and video production, web media optimization and performance
- Soft skills: international experience, teamwork, self-guided, clear communication with clients and stakeholders, translating business goals into design decisions, mentoring, managing projects from brief to launch
